name: Teleperformance (Partner)
desc:
Automotive Technical Service Representative | $16.00-$17.25/hr
Company: TP (Teleperformance)

What Your Day Will Look Like:
You’ll help customers who have questions or problems with a service or device. You’ll respond by phone, email, chat, or social media, ask questions to understand what is wrong, and guide the customer through basic troubleshooting. The posting specifically mentions WiFi and internet connection issues. If you can’t solve a problem, you’ll send it to the right support team. You may also process a payment or suggest an additional service if required. You’ll record details about each interaction so the company can track quality and results.

What the job is really hiring for: A first-level technical customer support representative who can handle a mix of customer contacts, basic troubleshooting, and detailed interaction notes. The title says automotive, but the posting does not describe hands-on vehicle repair or specific automotive systems; confirm what products or issues the team supports.

Calls and data work:
• Inbound and outbound: The posting says the role handles both inbound and outbound communications across phone, email, chat, and/or social media. It does not give call volume or say how much of the work is by phone versus other channels.
• Data entry and documentation: You’ll log call-related information for audits and reports and need accurate data entry. Documentation supports the customer contacts; the main work is troubleshooting and resolving customer issues.
• Sales: Upselling may be required, but the posting does not say how often.
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment. The assessment format is not specified.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

**Education Minimum:** High school diploma or equivalent. Must be at least 18 years old.

**Required Experience:** At least 6 months of technical and customer service experience.

**Preferred Experience:** Customer service and technical experience are preferred. A college degree is preferred but not required.


**Required Skills:**

- Ability to type at least 25 words per minute
- Comfort using desktop computers and general knowledge of Windows-based systems
- Strong computer skills, system navigation, accurate data entry, and typing
- Strong communication, listening, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
- Ability to follow procedures and collaborate with team members and support departments
- Ability to stay calm, prioritize tasks, and work well under pressure
- Ability to adapt to feedback, changing policies, and a structured schedule with varied shifts
- Ability to troubleshoot customer service or device issues, including WiFi and internet connectivity
- Ability to resolve or de-escalate issues and escalate when needed


**Best Fit:**

**This role is ideal for someone who:**

- Has at least six months of technical and customer service experience.
- Enjoys helping customers troubleshoot problems through several communication channels.
- Can stay calm with upset customers and know when to escalate an issue.
- Is comfortable documenting interactions, following procedures, and working a varied schedule.

**Not a Good Fit for someone who:**

- Dislikes customer contact by phone, email, chat, or social media.
- Is uncomfortable troubleshooting technical issues or explaining steps to customers.
- Has difficulty staying calm, following procedures, or recording accurate interaction notes.
- Needs a fixed shift or cannot meet the required home internet and workspace setup.

Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Apply through the TP iCIMS application page. Applications are accepted until positions are filled.
2. The posting says to expect an assessment. The assessment format is not specified.

Top 10 Resume Keywords:
• Technical customer support
• Automotive customer service
• Inbound and outbound communications
• Troubleshooting
• WiFi and internet connectivity
• Customer issue resolution
• De-escalation
• Call documentation
• Data entry accuracy
• Windows-based systems

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
• Tell us about a time you helped a customer solve a technical problem.
• How do you guide a customer through troubleshooting when they are frustrated?
• What do you do when you cannot solve an issue on the first contact?
• How do you keep accurate notes while moving quickly between customer contacts?
• How would you handle an upsell if it is required during a support interaction?

Pay, Schedule, Benefits, and Other Details:
Pay: $16.00-$17.25 per hour.
Schedule: Structured schedule with a variety of shifts; specific hours are not stated.
Benefits: Eligible team members may have medical, vision, and dental benefits; EAP resources, health and personal time off, leave programs, 401(k), life insurance, supplemental medical coverage, critical care insurance, pet insurance, FSA plans, and retailer discounts.
Work from home setup: Dedicated workspace near the router with a hardwired Ethernet connection; minimum 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload, ISP under 50 ms. Satellite, mobile data/hotspots, P2P, and VPN connections are not allowed. Proof of internet speed is required.
State eligibility: Oklahoma is included on the approved resident list.
Application deadline: Ongoing until positions are filled.
